description:
Create a 'Greatest Hits' re-release for the artist 'Iron Maiden' in the Chinook database. 

1. Connect to the Chinook SQLite database (/home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook.db).
2. Identify the Top 10 best-selling tracks for Iron Maiden (ArtistId=90) based on total Quantity in invoice_items.
3. Create a new Album record:
   - Title: 'Iron Maiden: Remastered Classics'
   - ArtistId: 90
4. Create 10 new Track records linked to this new album. For each of the Top 10 original tracks, create a clone with:
   - Name: Original Name + ' (Remastered)'
   - UnitPrice: 1.29
   - AlbumId: The new album ID
   - All other fields (Composer, Milliseconds, Bytes, GenreId, MediaTypeId) must match the original track.
5. Export a CSV manifest of the new tracks to '/home/ga/Documents/exports/new_release_manifest.csv' (columns: TrackId, Name, UnitPrice).
6. Save your SQL script to '/home/ga/Documents/scripts/remaster_release.sql'.
